_about.note: Evidence category of every number in data/tutorial.json and data/lore.json and of the fixed numbers in scripts/sim/tutorial_system.gd (Prompt 12: tutorial, campaign certification, optional story). Categories: requirement (taken from the prompt pack / brief, not a science value), design (tutorial or user-interface tuning, no source), balance (game tuning, no source; never a NASA figure), fiction (part of the invented 2079-2080 story), and source ids from docs/source_register.md. Nothing here is a NASA measurement unless a source id is named, and none of these numbers was checked with players.

hint_after_s.note: Real seconds without tutorial progress before the first hint appears. Initial tuning for ages 9-12; to be checked in playtest one (Prompt 14). Real seconds, so it does not change with the sol length.

hint_repeat_s.note: Real seconds between further hints while there is still no progress.

near_m.note: How close a crew member must come to a station for a 'go to' objective (a little more than the 2.6 m interaction reach in GameConfig).

move_m.note: Distance walked from the arrival spot that completes the first movement objective.

objective_params.metres.note: Same as move_m, written on the objective.

objective_params.min_l_per_hour.note: Greenhouse water allocation that completes the watering objective. One lettuce bed drinks 0.2 L per game hour (data/crops.json, balance), so 0.5 L/h keeps a bed moist.

objective_params.min_charge.note: Suit tank share (percent) at which the refill objective counts as done without a refill (nothing worth refilling).

objective_params.min.note: Radio stage needed by stage 8 and by the certification: CommsStage.stage(state) >= 1 (worker spec, Prompt 12).

stage9.hold_hours.note: Game hours the stage 9 fix must hold before it counts (about 49 real seconds at the default 20-minute sol).

stage9.lighting_line_room_kw.note: Fiction: the first crew's shared lighting line holds the grow lights plus at most this many kW of other room lights. The colony's real model has no such line; it exists only while the 'lighting_overload' fault of stage 9 is active, and its breaker only switches the Greenhouse circuit off (harmless).

stage9.limit_fraction.note: In code (TutorialSystem._inject_stage9): when the room lights the fault switches on are not at least 0.5 kW above the line's rating, the limit becomes 60 % of that load, so some rooms must always be switched off. With the current map the load is 5.2 kW and the limit stays 3.5 kW (switch off at least 1.7 kW).

stage9.variants.note: Three faults: the Greenhouse circuit switched off, the sun trackers switched off, the shared lighting line overloaded. The colony seed picks one with a fixed integer mix (variant_for_seed).

certification.sols.note: One full sol of game time (GameConfig.SOL_HOURS = 24.6598 game hours, the length of a Mars sol from S02) with the essential reserves above zero and no emergency recovery. From the brief: 'sustain essential operation with positive reserves for a full sol'.

certification.reserves.note: Battery, clean water, oxygen and food (worker spec, Prompt 12).

certification.empty_kwh_or_l_or_kg_or_me.note: In code (TutorialSystem.EMPTY): a store at or below this counts as zero (rounding in the store arithmetic is not a real shortage).

certification.resets_kept.note: In code: how many restarts of the certification sol are kept in the record (for the journal).

certification.sector_rule.note: A sector 'operates' when its tier is at least 1 (ProgressionSystem.tier). Tier 1 needs that sector's guided practical task and its explanation question, so it stands for restored equipment run by a crew that understands it; tiers never go down.

lore.records.note: Number of story records (the spec asks for 8 to 14).

lore.max_words.note: Each record text is at most 60 words (worker spec). tests/test_tutorial.gd counts them.

lore.record_numbers.note: Every number inside a record text (sol 198, 211, 219, 224; rack 3; 04:00; 60 percent; three nights; two sols) is part of the invented story. The only real values quoted are Mars gravity 3.73 m/s² (S01) and the sol length 24 h 39 min (S02).

lore.dust_share.note: The stage 4 explanation 'a panel 45 % covered gives about 45 % less power' describes the game's own linear dust model (PowerModel, GameBalance.panel_dust_start 0.45), not a measurement.

lore.grow_light_kw.note: The stage 6 explanation quotes the greenhouse light load from GameBalance.zone_load_kw (balance).
